cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is Speedbird 038, from Beijing to London, passing 1200 meters, climbing to 1800 meters, now contact Beijing Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是Speedbird 038，从北京飞往伦敦，正在通过1200米爬升至1800米，现在联系北京离场。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, BAW038, passing 1200 metres, climbing to 1800 metres.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，BAW038，正在通过1200米爬升至1800米。

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 038, Beijing Departure, identified, climb to 6000 meters on standard.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 038，北京离场，雷达识别，按标准气压爬升至6000米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 6000 metres on standard, BAW038.

cards.audioText: B: The aircraft ingested something, request descent to 3000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机吸入异物，申请下降至3000米。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, BAW038, foreign object ingestion, request descent to 3000 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，BAW038，飞机吸入异物，申请下降至3000米。

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 038, roger, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1011.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 038，收到，按QNH 1011下降至3000米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 3000 metres on QNH 1011, BAW038.

cards.audioText:
C: Speedbird 038, Beijing Departure, report intention.
B: Your turbine blades appear to be broken, request return to Beijing airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 038，北京离场，报告意图。你的涡轮叶片似乎损坏，申请返回北京机场。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, BAW038, request return to Beijing airport, our turbine blades appear to be broken.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，BAW038，申请返回北京机场，我们的涡轮叶片似乎损坏。

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 038, roger, turn right heading 180, information India, radar vector for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 038，收到，右转航向180，通播India，雷达引导落地。

cards.audioText:
C: Speedbird 038, report current situation.
B: Tell the controller that the port engine flamed out and you should land as soon as possible.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 038，报告当前情况。告诉管制员左发熄火，你需要尽快落地。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, our port engine flames out, request priority landing, BAW038.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，我们左发熄火，申请优先落地，BAW038。

cards.audioText:
C: Speedbird 038, roger, can you execute normal landing? do you require fuel dumping?
B: You can land normally and no need for fuel dumping.
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：Speedbird 038，收到，能否正常着陆？是否需要放油？
你可以正常着陆，不需要放油。
cards.referenceText: We can make a normal landing without dumping fuel, BAW038.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们可以正常着陆，不需要放油，BAW038。

cards.audioText: B: 2 minutes later. Tell the controller the fuel passage is blocked, only the auxiliary fuel tank is available, request priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 2分钟后，告诉管制员燃油通路堵塞，只有辅助油箱可用，申请优先落地。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, BAW038, fuel passage is blocked, now only the auxiliary fuel tank is operative, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，BAW038，燃油通路堵塞，目前只有辅助油箱可用，申请优先落地。

cards.audioText:
C: Speedbird 038, Beijing roger, report endurance.
B: Tell Control that your endurance is 30 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 038，北京收到，报告续航时间。告诉管制你的续航时间为30分钟。

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 038, roger, turn right heading 300, expect runway 01, caution surface wind 240, 12 meters per second, gusting to 18 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 038，收到，右转航向300，预计01跑道。注意地面风240度，12米/秒，阵风18米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 300, expect runway 01, BAW038.

cards.audioText: C:Speedbird 038, turn right heading 340, report established localizer.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 038，右转航向340，建立航向道后报告。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 340, report established localizer, BAW038.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向340，建立航向道后报告，BAW038。
北京进近，BAW038，已建立航向道。

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 038, continue approach, contact Beijing Tower 118.1, I will advise them of your problem.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 038，继续进近，联系北京塔台118.1，我会告知他们你的问题。

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 038, Beijing Tower, continue approach, report outer marker, caution surface wind 240, 12 meters per second, gusting to 18 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 038，北京塔台，继续进近，报告外指点标。注意地面风240度，12米/秒，阵风18米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Continue approach, report outer marker, BAW038.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续进近，报告外指点标，BAW038。

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 038, cleared to land runway 01, wind 240, 12 meters per second, report vacated.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 038，可以01跑道落地，风240度，12米/秒，脱离后报告。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land runway 01, report vacated, BAW038.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以01跑道落地，脱离后报告，BAW038。
